search_text: published ZDI-17-501 ZDI-CAN-4706 Trend Micro Control Manager BasePageSessionExpire External Entity Processing Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2017-07-31 CVE-2017-11390 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2017-11390 4.0 ['Trend Micro'] ['Control Manager'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on vulnerable installations of Trend Micro Control Manager. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within BasePageSessionExpire.cs. Due to the improper restriction of XML External Entity (XXE) reference, a specially crafted URI causes the XML parser to access the contents of this URI and embed these contents back into the XML document for further processing. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose sensitive information under the context of the current process. Trend Micro has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
